Cost Allocation

The cost allocation data below is provided as a supplement to the Open Access Transmission Tariff PDF, schedule 12 – appendix. The cost allocations on this page are updated periodically and in a similar time frame as when the cost allocations are filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.

Transmission zone short names are consistent with attachment J of the tariff.
